svg.desc: Every committed result set with its cases, outcomes and hazards
svg.text: 11 committed result sets across level 1 (reduced-order plant), level 2 (MuJoCo) and PX4 SITL, touching 6 hazards. All synthetic: none is verification evidence.
fault catalogue on 0° and 8° slopes, with and without mitigation
ankle 26500 N m, knee 22500 N m proposed (preliminary)
GCS link lost during observation, return-to-launch configured
GCS link lost, return-to-launch, walker has moved since take-off
GCS link lost during observation, land in place configured
Tip, stale home or partial agreement
Generated by tools/figures/sim_readme.py from sim/ inputs and committed results. Synthetic simulation output: a design aid with no evidence credit (evidence gate below).

g.text: Terms: GCS = ground control station · GPS = Global Positioning System · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · MuJoCo = Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact, the physics
engine for the level-2 walker model · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SU-nnn = UAV PX4 SITL
scenario · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · TS-nnn = architecture trade study · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
